title: Owner Governance Evidence Gate
concrete_capability_transition: Brownie release engineering now collects and guards owner-governance evidence plus local VM/SSH release artifact bundles for branch protection, required status checks, protected tags, remote CI provenance, signing or integrity authority, independent reviews, OSS license/publish posture, and cross-platform artifact readiness while keeping incomplete targets fail-closed.

strategic_capability_mapping.transition: The release gate now includes owner-governance evidence generation and guard checks, and the existing CI-invoked VSIX check path requires the owner-governance guard.
strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: This advances runtime-release-guard-ci by turning previously prose-only owner-controlled residuals into bounded, machine-checked evidence slots without claiming the owner decisions are complete.

answers.strategic_capabilities: The phase advances headless_autonomous_development by making owner-controlled release governance residuals externally inspectable, bounded, and fail-closed in the local release gate.
answers.new_capability: A contributor can run release:owner-governance-evidence to collect GitHub protection signals, CI provenance availability, integrity decision state, independent-review state, and OSS license/publish decision state, then run guard:owner-governance-evidence to reject malformed or falsely satisfied evidence.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: Before this phase, branch protection, tag protection, independent reviews, signing/integrity authority, CI provenance, and OSS posture were documented residuals but not machine-checked evidence slots, so automation could not distinguish unavailable owner authority from completed governance.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Brownie would continue to report owner-controlled release blockers only as prose, making autonomous release closure prone to either spinning or incorrectly declaring Product Ready.
answers.non_duplicative: This phase does not configure GitHub settings, create release tags, choose a license, sign artifacts, or approve reviews; it adds the missing evidence and guard layer around those existing owner-controlled residuals.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. No JSON-RPC method or Runtime protocol surface is added.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. The dry-run output is existing release-gate evidence, not a new user-facing summary or Runtime diagnostic endpoint.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: Build/release behavior changes: release:gate now includes local integrity verification, owner-governance evidence/guard commands, local release target validation, and local/SSH artifact bundle orchestration; readiness guards require owner-governance and local release target guard coverage in the VSIX check path.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: The autonomous release loop can now stop on precise owner-controlled evidence gaps instead of rereading overview documents or treating governance work as ambiguous implementation debt.
answers.milestone_progress: RRP-8.7 narrows runtime-release-guard-ci by closing the machine-checkable owner-governance evidence slice while preserving release-blocking owner decisions and external settings.

closed_debt: runtime-release-guard-ci existing-CI release gate dry-run binding
runtime-release-guard-ci owner-governance evidence and guard layer
non_goals: hosted services, scheduler, durable queue, supervisor, SaaS, RBAC, Vault, BDK, or Enterprise admin

reject_when: phase claims Runtime Release Ready or removes release-blocking artifact, audit, governance, workflow, review, or owner-setting evidence
pnpm --filter brownie-vsix check does not invoke pnpm --workspace-root release:gate -- --dry-run
guard:release-contract or guard:runtime-release-readiness does not fail closed when the VSIX check path omits the release gate dry-run
workflow files are modified without workflow-scope credentials or owner-approved equivalent path
license, publish settings, tags, release assets, or signing infrastructure are changed by Runtime automation

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: RRP-8.7 changes release/readiness guard engines and package scripts. Review must confirm owner-governance evidence remains bounded, owner-controlled settings are not self-approved, fail-closed statuses remain release-blocking, and runtime_release_ready remains false.

exit_criteria: scripts/guard-release-contract.mjs rejects VSIX check paths that omit the release gate dry-run.
scripts/guard-runtime-release-readiness.mjs rejects VSIX check paths that omit the release gate dry-run.
pnpm --workspace-root release:gate -- --dry-run passes and lists the mandatory release gate command plan.
pnpm --filter brownie-vsix check passes with runtime_release_ready=false and release_ready=false.

accepted_capability: The existing CI-invoked VSIX check path exercises the release gate dry-run.
Release and readiness guards keep that dry-run binding mandatory.
Direct workflow hardening remains blocked by missing workflow-scope credentials.
Runtime Release Ready remains false until release evidence and owner-controlled settings are complete.
behavior_evidence: node --test scripts/guard-release-contract.test.mjs validates fail-closed release gate dry-run binding checks.
node --test scripts/guard-runtime-release-readiness.test.mjs validates fail-closed existing CI path coverage.
pnpm --workspace-root guard:release-contract validates the live Runtime release contract and VSIX check binding.
pnpm --workspace-root guard:runtime-release-readiness validates the live audit and VSIX check binding.
pnpm --workspace-root release:gate -- --dry-run emits the mandatory release gate command plan.
safety_boundary: Rust Runtime remains execution, admission, replay, permission, MCP, workspace mutation, durable state, protocol, and completion authority.
CLI and VSIX remain thin transport/projection clients and cannot grant Runtime authority.

GitHub workflow settings, branch protection, protected tags, signing authority, license choice, and publish posture remain owner-controlled; branch protection, protected tags, interim integrity authority, and Apache-2.0/manual publication posture have been explicitly provided and are machine-checked.
Raw prompt, provider output, file content, absolute/canonical path, secret, environment value, executable content, and process output are not persisted as release evidence.
non_goals: Does not claim Runtime Release Ready.
Does not generate or publish release tags, packages, signatures, or public release assets; license metadata may change only from explicit owner decision evidence.

Does not add hosted scheduler, daemon, durable queue, supervisor, SaaS control plane, customer RBAC, Vault, billing, BDK, Enterprise admin, generic shell, arbitrary process execution, or remote Git capability expansion.
rejected_alternatives: Rejected editing .github/workflows/ci.yml because active GitHub credentials still lack workflow scope.
Rejected claiming runtime-release-guard-ci closed because release artifacts, audits, provenance, governance, and owner decisions remain incomplete.
Rejected a docs-only update because the existing CI-invoked check path must execute and guard the release gate dry-run.
technical_debt: runtime-release-guard-ci remains open until cross-platform artifacts, cross-platform artifact smoke tests, direct workflow enforcement or stronger owner-approved CI enforcement, and release-artifact provenance are complete.

Branch protection, protected tags, remote CI provenance evidence, Apache-2.0/manual publication posture, interim owner-approved integrity authority, and owner-designated independent reviews are now machine-checked.
next_capability_rationale: Continue with the next bounded runtime-release-guard-ci slice that can be completed without workflow scope or owner-only settings, or wait for workflow-scope credentials for direct workflow hardening.

runtime_release_dod: Closed RRP-1 through RRP-7.2 and RRP-5.18 evidence remains in force and is not reimplemented.

RRP-8.7 and R-20 are now reflected in current release metadata: owner-governance evidence remains fail-closed, and repo-fixed historical ledger fixtures are wired into CI-reachable release checks without claiming Runtime Release Ready.

Missing cross-platform release artifacts, cross-platform smoke tests, artifact-bound checksums, signatures or integrity proof, provenance, workflow run enforcement, and tested commit remain release-blocking.
runtime_boundary_contracts: No new RPC surface is added.
CLI and VSIX remain thin clients over Runtime-owned contracts.
external_control_plane_responsibilities: External scheduling, durable queues, worker leases, hosted isolation, metrics, alerts, SLA, tenant administration, billing, and secret-provider operations remain outside local Runtime v0.
external_adapter_responsibilities: Forge, pull request, review, notification, SIEM, OTel, language verifier, customer integration, and hosted MCP adapter responsibilities remain outside this phase.
commercial_solution_readiness: Packaging publication, notarization, enterprise administration, operational runbooks, support, and commercial release decisions remain owner-controlled or later release work.
Cargo license is Apache-2.0 by owner decision; Cargo publish remains disabled until an explicit release publication approval.

technical_debt.next_action: Add actual vulnerability/license audits, cross-platform artifacts and smoke tests, governance evidence, and direct workflow or stronger owner-approved CI enforcement before Runtime Release Ready.
Owner must provide workflow-scope credentials for direct .github workflow gate closure.
Keep public publication manual until cross-platform artifacts, smoke tests, integrity evidence, and independent reviews are complete.
